audio.design: One analog ring, one dial return, three relay locks, one terminal confirmation, low room hum.

scenes.primaryMessage: The next client is already on the line.
scenes.evidenceObject: A single signal pulse physically begins at the telephone cable connection.
scenes.entry: Cream paper field opens from navy; the approved phone lands into the right side.
scenes.readableHold: Headline and phone hold while the isolated dial makes one restrained mechanical return.
scenes.exit: The one red cable extends toward the center and pulls the camera into the route.
scenes.continuityOut: One phone remains seated on the right; one cable and one pulse travel toward the center.

scenes.primaryMessage: One system moves the request from website to conversation to CRM.
scenes.evidenceObject: The packet touches and mechanically locks exactly three ordered system stations.
scenes.entry: The camera continues along the same cable from the phone scene.
scenes.readableHold: Each station stays readable after pulse contact; all activated states remain visible.
scenes.exit: The packet enters CRM and the navy CRM field begins expanding from that physical point.
scenes.continuityIn: One phone remains seated on the right; one cable and one pulse travel toward the center.
scenes.continuityOut: All three stations are locked; the same unbranched cable reaches CRM and the pulse is absorbed.

scenes.evidenceObject: The exact owner-supplied logo plate sits above one settled red underline.
scenes.entry: The CRM field expands into navy and the cable straightens into one underline.
scenes.readableHold: Original logo and CTA remain perfectly still for the last 24 frames.
scenes.exit: No exit; stable final brand lockup.
scenes.continuityIn: All three stations are locked; the same unbranched cable reaches CRM and the pulse is absorbed.
scenes.continuityOut: One original logo plate is unobstructed; one red line is settled; final CTA is readable and static.
